mutation.note: DICT_ADD(pqrs, key, "OK" -> other text) in MarkPqrRemarks: the stored text is only ever compared with "Fail", so any other text gives the same remarks. LET(outRow, 2 -> 3) and LET(outRow, outRow + 1 -> + 2) in ListProblemWps and in WriteProcessSummary only leave blank gap rows between the written rows; the SORT that follows in each TASK puts blank rows last, beyond the used range, so both final sheets are the same
